## Stage-A work items (all offline, unit/Docker-testable)
1. Entrypoint ambient caps (D-P0.15f-1 + F6): add +setgid,+sys_chroot to entrypoint.sh; extend privsep-check.sh
   + Dockerfile.privsep-test + privsep.docker.test.ts to prove harness→agent setpriv drop (no setresgid EPERM),
   negative control without setgid, and agent-via-harness still denied secrets.
2. Credential injector (D-P0.15f-2): new streaming reverse proxy running as harness; stamps
   x-rhema-proxy-credential (injectProxyCredential); agent ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL → injector, injector upstream =
   egress-proxy. Wire into harness-main. scrubbed-env still forbids credential. Unit-test stamping/forwarding/
   streaming + credential-less request 403s (validateProxyRequest).
3. Guided-retry /work idempotency (K3): materializeWork pre-write chmod 0644 (swallow ENOENT) so a re-run over a
   0444 file does not EACCES. Unit-test the re-run path.
4. Vendor native claude binary (F1): Dockerfile installs vendor/claude-agent-sdk-linux-x64 → node_modules pkg,
   chmod +x, chown agent + build-time resolve/executable assertion (guarded on presence); vendor/README step;
   pathToClaudeCodeExecutable optional field threaded + mapped.
5. Skill discovery (F2): stageSkills() symlinks /app/skills/<name> → $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/skills/<name>; options
   set skills:'all' (+ optional settingSources). Wire into harness-main. Unit-test staging layout.
6. /work layout (F3): materializeWork honors entry.root via roots{project,persona}; harness spawn cwd + read =
   request.cwd (/work/project); persona root /work/personas/<id>. Update materialize test to real seed entries
   (drafts/v1.md, root project). Assert hook ALLOWs the draft read at /work/project/drafts/v1.md.
7. Model (F4): options.model = MAIN_MODEL[tier]; fix roster base-research claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 →
   claude-haiku-4-5; add claude-haiku-4-5 to RATE_TABLE_V1 (make priceable, additive). Test every roster+main
   model id is on its tier allowlist AND priceable.
8. Engine options mapping (F5): toSdkOptions builds REAL SDK Options only (drop skillsDir/cacheControlTtl/
   maxSubagentDepth/maxConcurrentSubagents/sessionStore; add model/skills/pathToClaudeCodeExecutable/settingSources).
   Document caps are advisory/un-enforced (defense = proxy + uid split).

## Stage-B risks DISCOVERED OFFLINE this run (record for D-P0.06-1 — NOT Stage-A regressions)
While mapping toSdkOptions to the real vendored sdk.d.ts, two PRE-EXISTING engine↔SDK shape mismatches surfaced
(the OLD identity toSdkOptions forwarded them verbatim too — not introduced by P0.15g). They sit exactly at the
"first live SDK exercise" boundary the ticket reserves for D-P0.06-1 (diagnosed live WITH LOGS). NOT blind-fixed
here — the fix needs the live SDK to test against, and one needs a design input (a subagent system prompt):
- SDK `AgentDefinition` (sdk.d.ts:38) REQUIRES `prompt: string`; our roster `AgentDef` (roster.ts) has none.
  For the first green Review the intake phase is judge-class (no subagent spawn — the hook denies Agent/Task),
  so it may not fire, but a research/fan-out phase would. Fix at D-P0.06-1 with the real error in hand.
- SDK `hooks` want `Partial<Record<HookEvent, HookCallbackMatcher[]>>` where a matcher is `{matcher?, hooks:
  HookCallback[]}` with a 3-arg callback; we pass `{ PreToolUse: [callback] }` (bare fn array). Remap in
  toSdkOptions once the live shape is confirmed.
These are the legitimate D-P0.06-1 residue (peers of K5, the completion-oracle parsing). Flagged in the PR.

### Worker startup diagnosis (live)
- Root cause of "stuck queued": worker rev 00003/04 appeared hung but was actually VERY SLOW to start over Cloud Run Direct-VPC egress: SM key load ~2 min (18:31:41→18:33:38), k8s import + pg-boss each ~1-2 min → ~15 min to reach "[worker] registered". First run's pg-boss run.start job EXPIRED (15-min default) before consumption.
- Then: pg-boss run.reap cron hit "Connection terminated due to connection timeout" → UNHANDLED EventEmitter 'error' → ERR_UNHANDLED_ERROR → exit(1). Worker crash-restarts → slow start again → cycle. api uses same DB path + stays warm (min-instance) so it's unaffected.
- FIX (committed): boss.on('error')/pool.on('error')/redis.on('error') handlers so a transient infra blip is logged, not fatal (a background service must not exit on it). Worker-only rebuild.
- Next: redeploy, confirm worker stays up + registers, drive fresh run → provision → GKE Job → the agent-launch chain (the ticket's actual focus: uid 10002, caps, injector, SDK→proxy).

### Worker startup reliability (the remaining blocker)
- Root cause: heavy dynamic imports over Cloud Run gVisor cold FS are SLOW — SM ~90s-2min, @kubernetes/client-node ~5min. The 5-min k8s import stalls startup until pg-boss's DB connection times out → "timeout exceeded when trying to connect" thrown from boss.work → exit(1) BEFORE run consumers register. --cpu 2 --cpu-boost did NOT fix (it's FS/network, not CPU).
- FIX: lazy GKE launcher (defer the @kubernetes import to first launch) so consumers register immediately + worker stays stable; import cost paid once at first provision. Worker rebuild in progress.
- Digests: run-task(placeholder)=63dbee26; worker(lazy)=pending. proxy=14ef1097, api=1bdf6fa1.
